protocol: research/protocol/PROTOCOL-v1.md, frozen 2026-10-13, section 4 E1-E6 and section 6.2

actor.tool: GitHub connected repository and web-published abstracts

scope: Four already verified R004 source records flagged in the R004-to-R006 empirical handoff; no general search recall or corpus-selection claim.

decisions.reason: Human cooperative Battleship study compares natural versus mechanical robot speech, with verbal advice acceptance and response time; method and results described. Publisher DOI and University of Surrey abstract agree with the R004 source record. The voice pre-study and main study must not be treated as a single or two independently eligible samples without checking the report.
decisions.access_limitation: R004 recorded abstract-only access and a refused ACM PDF (HTTP 403). This pass read an institutional publication abstract, not complete source pages or numerical tables.
decisions.next_action: Obtain lawful full text and the complete methods/results; determine which of the pre-study and main experiment independently meets E2/E3 and resolve study, experiment, sample and effect units without double-counting.

decisions.reason: The institutional abstract reports people assisting a robot through a maze, synthetic/default robot-voice comparison, repair strategies, in-game behaviour and trust questionnaires. It is an apparent comparative primary study with human voice-message interaction and measured outcomes.
decisions.access_limitation: R004 recorded abstract-only access and a refused ACM PDF (HTTP 403); this pass used the Manchester publication abstract, not the full report or independent data.
decisions.next_action: Obtain and inspect lawful methods/results and voice exemplars; verify actual assignment, outcomes and participants; test possible overlap with the distinct Romeo 2023 publication before establishing independent samples.

decisions.reason: The abstract identifies 95 adult raters, human/humanoid/synthesized voice clips and human-likeness, eeriness and likability outcomes. Whether isolated voice-rating clips are machine-generated system messages under G01/E2, rather than decontextualized voice stimuli, is unresolved. Retain rather than exclude by preference or style.
decisions.access_limitation: R004 records a hashed, available publisher PDF and selected abstract/results reading; this pass inspected the Frontiers abstract on the public HTML page only. It did not validate the previously retained PDF hash or complete-text eligibility.
decisions.next_action: Inspect stimulus transcripts/task context and protocol G01 against the full report; resolve E2 explicitly before any inclusion/exclusion or numerical extraction.

decisions.reason: Institutional abstract describes two video-based online studies manipulating robot voice and empathic behaviour with context-dependent trust outcomes. E2 remains uncertain until the full study confirms what audio messages were delivered and whether they satisfy G01; video-based presentation is not an automatic exclusion.
decisions.access_limitation: R004 stored metadata_only/no abstract; this pass accessed a Heriot-Watt hosted abstract, not a full paper. The repository source dates the conference at 2023-08-28; the institutional page labels publication 2023-11-13. This date disagreement is retained as metadata context, not silently corrected.
decisions.next_action: Inspect full text, exact robot voice stimuli, and study design; resolve E2 and sample independence separately from Romeo 2025. Both publications have distinct verified DOIs; neither a duplicate-publication merge nor independent-study assertion is authorized.

publication_identity_review.basis: Overlapping authors, different titles, years and described tasks (video-based contextual trust versus robot maze/repair); overlapping authors and distinct settings alone cannot establish same or independent participants.
publication_identity_review.action: Do not alias sources, assert independent samples, count studies or create STUDY/SAMPLE records until a source-supported relationship is available.

acceptance.limitations: This issue-scoped, noncanonical decision handoff is not loaded by the live registry or counted in generated evidence flow. Only the first-pass abstracts were accessed in this run; no second reviewer or human screening, data extraction, complete methods verification or publication-family adjudication is claimed.
